name: Yagami Reon
source:
A talented musician who quit the music club to play death metal guitar in the pop music appreciation club. Projects a tough guy image with his rude manner of speaking, but seems to be more bark than bite.

Stats: luck 3 / intelligence 3 / popularity 2 / special ability 5 / physical strength 2 / influence 1
Special Skill: perfect pitch
